description: This file defines a Twig token parser class TypesTokenParser, which processes custom Twig syntax for declaring variable types within templates. It includes methods for parsing type mappings and integrates with Twig's parsing infrastructure.

classes.name: TypesTokenParser
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractTokenParser that handles parsing of custom 'types' tags in Twig templates, enabling declaration of variable types with optional annotations.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'types' tag and returns a TypesNode with the parsed type information.

methods.name: parseSimpleMappingExpression
methods.description: Parses a simple key-value mapping of types from the token stream, handling syntax like {foo: 'number', bar?: 'string'}.

parameters.name: TokenStream $stream
parameters.description: The token stream to parse from.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name this parser handles, which is 'types'.
